windows: ncc.exe project sync PROJECT --main main.n --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
ncc.exe project link PROJECT --main main.n --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --out bin/NAME.exe --linker C:/msys64/mingw64/bin/gcc.exe
linux: target/release/ncc project sync PROJECT --main main.n --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
target/release/ncc project link PROJECT --main main.n --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --out bin/NAME --linker /usr/bin/gcc

limitations: Two support objects per project are retained from Stage0; this is not a Stage3 compiler.
Windows objects link with GCC/MinGW, not an MSVC certification.
Source snapshots of earlier standalone family evidence precede the final NUL-aware process capture; this manifest identifies the integrated build.
